meaning:
κατα-νοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;]
to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: Act.7:31-32; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.7:3, Luk.6:41 12:24, 27 20:23, Act.11:6 27:39, Rom.4:19; with accusative of person(s), Heb.3:1 10:24, Jas.1:23-24 (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,
Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of…
Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
